diagnosis.plainEnglish: The scorecard itself was not shown to be defective. The failure occurred because the active browser-control interface did not reliably support the frozen load, version, and post-reload interaction sequence, and it generated a localhost service-worker request that violated the zero-failed-request rule.
requiredRemedy: Prepare and test a browser-control runner on a synthetic local page before freezing a replacement execution plan.
Use the supported normal-load signal followed by an explicit wait for the AI Extension accordion before each interaction.
Record the Chromium version through Runtime.evaluate of navigator.userAgent rather than Browser.getVersion.

Determine whether /service-worker.js is browser-generated stale-origin traffic; isolate the staging origin or define a source-grounded handling rule without weakening genuine failed-request detection.
Freeze fresh evidence paths and a new immutable activation; do not reuse or relabel this failed execution.
